title: Lush Tweaks
description: Small QoL changes to vanilla tools and items!
body:
Lush Tweaks is a small quality-of-life resource pack that adds subtle visual improvements to Minecraft without changing gameplay.

### Features
- New 2D arrow model
- A full stack of arrows visually turns into a quiver
- Name tags appear blank until they are renamed

### IMPORTANT
To use the custom arrow model, you must have **Entity Model Features (EMF)** installed:
https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features
